content:
Sample: secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-42487244
Project: libxml2
Public id: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4766294854074368

Issue description:
A use-after-free in xmlXPathNodeSetAdd() can occur during XPath evaluation when resolving ID references. The code fails to clean up ID entries when no DTD is present, leaving stale pointers that are later dereferenced, leading to crashes or memory corruption.
